factual_basis_before: San Francisco police stopped an unoccupied Cruise autonomous Chevrolet Bolt after officers observed a lighting issue. Video and subsequent reporting showed the vehicle initially stopped, then moved farther down the road before stopping again with hazard lights. Cruise said the vehicle yielded to the police vehicle and then moved to the nearest safe location. The local report separately preserves police and provider statements. The official city filing documents a later meeting and video-review opportunity. It does not establish a command to remain stationary or loss of a feasible admissible route.
